summary.text: Shen Shang calls Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable the foundational pillar of human path for creating the painting world that derives human path's foundations from a million years of mortal scenes.

claims.text: Shen Shang sits in the shade at a street corner in the painting world of Divine Emperor City, still covered in injuries and resembling a beggar. Sun Yao places porridge and steamed buns in front of him. He overhears Sun Yao, Chen Da Jiang, and Xiao Qi Xing transmitting their conversations, and he names those three as Heavenly Court’s Gu Immortal seeds. In history, he treats The Legends of Ren Zu as the greatest human path true inheritance. The book seems shallow and is profound to the limit. Only a small group of people can comprehend its true essence and create human path killer moves. Those killer moves are too few and rare to establish a path. Human path has great potential, but it has no foundations set upon it and has been unable to develop until now.

Xiao Qi Xing tells Sun Yao and Chen Da Jiang that the painting world is vivid because of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable’s contented lifestyle killer move. The three of them were nominated by their sects to be trained by Heavenly Court and sent here for further nurturing. Their sects want them to cultivate human path as their main path and to strive to ascend using it. Cultivation of human path here is not fake. Human path Gu worms obtained in the painting can be taken outside and used. Only city guards can get soldier Gu, sergeant Gu, lieutenant Gu, captain Gu, and others, which can build a strong foundation in human path cultivation.
Shen Shang judges Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable’s arrangement vast and grand. He also finds the human path developments here helpful to himself.
